thread:
olivia: Starting preflight for Barnes Health on-prem / VPC delivery. Key goals: air-gapped seed registry, GPU pool sizing (8xA100 per rack), MTU and jumbo frames check, BGP peer with customer edge, and secure KMS handoff. ETA: tomorrow 09:00 local. Asking for ops checklist + known gotchas.

chris: copying checklist from last delivery but note Barnes has 2x10Gb transit links and a firewall that rewrites TCP MSS. watch MTU on the host and on the customer router.

samir: for the seed registry we need to ship the seeder tar + sig on encrypted USB and confirm SHA256 on their bastion before load. also confirm offline RPM repo for CUDA drivers.

irene: noted. I'll coordinate with field engineer on the USB handoff window. Is there a preferred encryption key rotation for KMS import? Barnes requires HSM-wrapped keys.

olivia: yes, customer requires HSM import. Procedure: generate data key locally, wrap with their public HSM key, send via courier. We must log the wrapping operation. samir pls add script snippet.

samir: snippet (run on sec machine):
```
# generate and wrap
openssl rand -hex 32 > datakey.hex
openssl rsautl -encrypt -inkey barnes_pub.pem -pubin -in datakey.hex -out datakey.wrapped
sha256sum datakey.wrapped
```

chris: network checklist: confirm BGP ASN, announce prefixes, verify MD5 password on eBGP, confirm route filters. Also confirm customer permits our /24 for cluster-services.

ashley: on GPU sizing — ops asked for steady-state 1200 tokens/s across 10 qps baseline. with 8xA100 per rack, we should reserve 15% headroom. cost note: this configuration adds ~20% over hosted equivalent due to on-prem support and SLAs.

olivia: let's capture cost delta in the handoff doc for the account team. include expected monthly OPEX for data transfers and maintenance.

chris: bring-up steps I'm planning to run:
1) verify seed registry tar on bastion: `sha256sum seeder.tar.gz`
2) load to local registry: `ctr images import seeder.tar.gz`
3) `kubectl apply -f cluster-bootstrap.yaml`
4) verify nodes: `kubectl get nodes -o wide` -> expect GPUs to show as allocatable.

samir: paste of expected `kubectl get nodes` snippet (sanitized):
```
NAME           STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION   GPU
node-01        Ready    worker   5m    v1.28     8
node-02        Ready    worker   4m    v1.28     8
```

irene: firewall exceptions: allow registry ports 5000/tcp between bastion and registry, allow NTP (123), allow KMS wrap/unwrap from wrapping host only. Customer firewall will block outgoing 443 by default — ensure egress exceptions for our telemetry if agreed.

deploy-bot: CI build 86 passed for `barnes/seeder:release-86` :white_check_mark:

olivia: run the validation plan after bootstrap:
- node health (kubelet logs, OOMs)
- NVML sanity tests (run `nvidia-smi topo -m`)
- small gen test against local registry (50 concurrent requests, 1s latency SLA)
- KV cache warmup e2e path (measure cache hit ratio)

chris: quick MTU test to run from bastion to node: `ping -M do -s 8972 <node-ip>` if fails, drop to 1460 and report. Also check iptables/tcp_mss clamping on firewall.

samir: airgap artifact checklist I'm bringing:
- seeder.tar.gz + signature (on encrypted USB)
- driver rpms and DKMS packages
- offline apt/yum repo snapshot
- certbundle.pem for registry and gateways
- bootstrap manifests and image digests file

ashley: cost callout for sales: reserved on-prem support + quarterly on-site adds ~$12k/mo; include a 3% hardware ops surcharge to buffer courier and spare parts.

irene: handoff timeline suggestion: tomorrow 09:00 ops kickoff, 09:30 courier arrival, 10:00 registry load, 11:00 kube bootstrap, 12:30 validation start, 15:00 initial acceptance smoke. Customer prefers slack updates + daily stand at 17:00 UTC.

olivia: tagging runbook items for the delivery packet. chris/samir pls confirm you both have access to customer's jump host creds and the barnes_pub.pem.

chris: I have jump host creds. will request barnes_pub.pem from security if not in keyvault.

samir: I need the HSM public key — @irene can you confirm courier will provide the key file on arrival?

irene: yes courier will include `hsm_pub.pem` on USB. we will verify fingerprint over the phone with customer's infra lead before importing.

olivia: final acceptance criteria to include in handoff doc:
- all nodes Ready and GPUs allocatable
- registry images validated and signatures match
- BGP session established and routes received
- NVML/gpu-sanity tests pass
- KMS keys wrapped and logged into audit
If all pass, mark cluster status `delivered` and handover to CS with runbook and costs.

chris: one more gotcha: Barnes uses asymmetric routing for monitor traffic. add source-based routing rule on our side for monitoring subnets.

samir: ok prepping `seeder-signature.txt` and node preflight script. i'll drop artifacts to `/tmp/barnes-delivery/` on the bastion and share checksums here when ready.

ashley: LGTM. will add cost appendix to the packet and notify account exec. :thumbsup:

olivia: great work team — keep updates here during the window. I'll post a concise handoff doc after 17:00 with itemized tasks and owner tags.
